issues.message: CHK-004 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

4 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Committed pilot campaign runner emitting RUN-RECORD-conformant arm-run directories + Mechanical fixture-leakage audit over the generated corpus are performed simultaneously?)

story hit 1 high-risk signal(s): Production/Emergency. Recommend stricter review standards (>= 3 preMortem scenarios, explicit rollback path). If this story only mentions rather than modifies that area (false positive), run lattice story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-beeb","category":"<category>","reason":"..."}' to fully roll back the auto-elevation (after all auto-elevated riskSignals are dismissed, priority auto-reverts and high-risk gates are lifted).

understanding still has 2 undigested unknowns: Per-cell host invocation shape (claude CLI flags for non-interactive fixture task execution) — resolve during CHK-001 implementation against one smoke cell before the full pilot; Wall-clock per cell (expect minutes); if the pilot exceeds the session, run-pilot.mjs resume handles continuation
